name: FFS_DWH_EXPORT_FILE
description: Defines a list of files to be exported by Daily Extract.

columns.name: FILE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the export file.

columns.name: FILE_NAME
columns.description: Specifies file name a data to be exported to.

columns.name: ENTITY
columns.description: Name of the entity for which data is exported.

columns.name: FORMAT
columns.description: File format of exporting data: xml or csv.

columns.name: ARCHIVE
columns.description: Specifies type of the archive of the exporting file.

columns.name: FOLDER
columns.description: Specifies a folder in which export file will be located.

columns.name: NAME_ARCHIVE
columns.description: Specifies format of the archive file name.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_ARCHIVE
columns.description: Deprecated. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: CSV_FIELDS_TERMINATED
columns.description: Specifies a separator which is used to delimit fields in csv file.

columns.name: CSV_ENCLOSED_HEADER
columns.description: Specifies a symbol which is used for csv file header fields enclosing. .

columns.name: CSV_ENCLOSED
columns.description: Specifies a symbol for csv fields enclosing.

columns.name: CSV_LINE_END_IS
columns.description: Specifies a symbol which is added at the end of each csv line.

columns.name: CSV_EMPTY_ENCLOSED
columns.description: Specifies a symbol which is used for enclosing of empty csv fields.

columns.name: ENCODING
columns.description: Specifies file encoding. UTF-8 is used by default.

columns.name: REALTIME_ENABLED
columns.description: If this flag is set then realtime data update is enabled.

columns.name: CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: Link to the channel the export file belongs. Reference to Message Agent table.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ID
columns.description: Outbound Integration Channel name.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
